text:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH severity: billing.metering.token_drift detected for prod. Auto-incident INC-2026-0453 created. Alerts: token-count divergence across aggregator shards > 15% for multiple customers.
Erin: @channel I'm on it, taking lead. Can someone confirm visible customer impact and whether any charges were issued?
Marc: Quick summary from infra: emitter backlog experienced a short replay between 02:03-02:12 UTC. Some messages re-emitted and the aggregator accepted duplicates before dedupe window stabilized. Early diffs show inflated token counts for a handful of customers.
Raj: Observed consumer reconnects + redis stream lag at 02:04. We saw spike in replays.
Marc: Sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:05:02Z emitter-processor INFO emit_count=1200 backlog=4500 replay=true
2026-03-15T02:06:11Z token-aggregator WARN duplicate_key=abcd1234 window=10s
```
Ana: Billing here — our systems generated overage flags for 4 customers (masked ids). No invoices have been finalized yet, but flags triggered automated emails. Need freeze ASAP.
Liz: Customer Success reporting 2 direct inbound emails from customers about overage notices. They're worried and asking for explanation/credits.
Erin: Immediate plan: 1) Pause generation of new billing flags for the affected window. 2) Enable shadow emitter path to validate dedupe. 3) Throttle aggregator flushes and start reconciliation job comparing raw emits -> metered counts. Who takes which?
Marc: I'll flip emitter to shadow mode and restart the connector. Command I'll run: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-connector -n prod --grace-period=30`. Will monitor emit rates.
Raj: I'll apply a temporary consumer rate limit to reduce replays: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.prod/limits -d '{"service":"emitter","rate":5000}'` and watch redis lag.
infra-bot: Action acknowledgment: emitter-connector restart started, 3/3 pods recycling.
Marc: Restart done, shadow path enabled. Early telemetry shows duplicate warnings drop by ~70% in the last 2m.
Ana: I've set billing-subsystem -> do-not-flag for window 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-15T02:15:00Z. No further automated emails should be sent.
Erin: Good. Marc, start the reconciliation diff and estimate excess tokens so billing can decide on credits. Raj, keep monitoring redis and consumer lag. Liz, prepare customer-safe messaging (don't promise credits yet).
Marc: Starting reconciliation: comparing raw_emits stream counts -> metered_agg counts. Preliminary estimate: ~1.2M excess tokens across 4 accounts (A,B,C,D). Backfill job kicked off (job id backfill-1735).
Liz: Draft message ready, pinging Erin for approval: "We detected a metering incident which flagged possible overages for your account between 02:00-02:15 UTC. We're investigating and will follow up with a resolution and any credits if needed."
Erin: Fine to send once we confirm reconciliation. Do not send credit specifics yet.
Ana: Finance looped in. If reconciliation confirms overcount, we'll issue adjustments/credits and notify impacted customers.
Raj: Consumer rate limit applied, redis lag recovered to normal in last 5m. No further replays seen.
infra-bot: backfill-1735 job status: running (0:12 elapsed).
Marc: Backfill completed at 03:18 UTC. Diff executed: net delta reduced to within tolerance after dedupe; effective overcount reduced to ~15k tokens after corrections. Looks like many earlier duplicates were auto-deduped by post-processing; only a small subset remained.
Ana: Based on final numbers, we will NOT bill for the residual delta and will retract the overage flags. I'm going to trigger flag-retract for the 4 customers and mark them for credit review (internal).
Liz: Notifying the 2 customers who contacted us now with a short note and apology; offering them the option to request credits — finance will handle.
Erin: On-call handoff: I'll stay for 30 more minutes and then hand to Raj for monitoring. Postmortem owners: Marc (root cause + infra), Ana (billing impact + customer communications).
Marc: Root cause hypothesis: transient emitter reconnect + redis stream replay coupled with a brief race in aggregator dedupe window. Will capture orchestration timeline and PR to harden dedupe.
Raj: I'll keep an eye on metrics and alerts; will escalate if anything slides.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-0453 status updated -> mitigated. Follow-up tasks created: INC-2026-0453-FU1 (postmortem), INC-2026-0453-FU2 (billing-credit-audit).
Erin: Thanks everyone. Closing channel notices, will convert to a postmortem thread and TL;DR for execs.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0453 marked RESOLVED (mitigated). Follow-ups required.
